title: What is the Ultraviolet Catastrophe?
summary: A detailed 40-minute explanation of the ultraviolet catastrophe, covering Rayleigh and Jeans' classical treatment of blackbody radiation and Planck's quantum hypothesis. It follows the Eisberg and Resnick textbook treatment.
why: Recommended for a math-heavy but thorough treatment of the ultraviolet catastrophe and the history of the experiments.
